why: Boards of our own made from a PCBench board by one stated edit, prepared and routed as the others are (pcbench.py reads this file). The edit names what it removes exactly; preparing fails if it matches anything but `count` items. A variant joins the tiers it names.

variants.why: The F.Mask text beside U103 overlaps pins 8, 9 and 11 and bares pads of many nets, so no track leaves those pins without a mask bridge: the designer's own routing adds them (tools/netcheck.py). Without the text the board routes clean (2026-11-06: 12 s at 120 s, 78 vias).
